# LokTube 1.5.7

- Correct the **Home → For you** layout: three equally sized videos in the first desktop row, then four videos in every following desktop row at the regular desktop breakpoint.
- Add left/right navigation arrows directly over the Home account-topic strip edges. Arrows appear only when additional topics are offscreen in that direction and disappear at the scroll boundaries.
- Preserve horizontal touch/trackpad scrolling, keyboard focus and reduced-motion preferences, and retain responsive layouts on narrower windows.
- Add desktop regression coverage for three-then-four video columns and topic-strip arrow visibility, placement and navigation.
